texts.ApiContractChecker.Diagnosis:ExtractorNo: No failure identity extractor accepted the signal.
texts.ApiContractChecker.Diagnosis:ProbeNotFou: The requested diagnosis probe is not registered.
texts.ApiContractChecker.Diagnosis:UnsafeProbe: The probe target is outside the snapshot server and path allow-list.
texts.ApiContractChecker.Diagnosis:Validation:: Status code must be between 100 and 599.
A problem error must contain a pointer or code.
texts.Diagnosis:Report:Title: API failure diagnosis
texts.Diagnosis:Report:Detail: Hypotheses are ranked from structured HTTP fields, the live snapshot and related findings.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-CD-01:Title: Response schema changed
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-CD-01:Detail: A related finding shows that the response schema changed.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-CD-01:NextCheck: Review response schema findings for this operation.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-CD-02:Title: A required request field was created
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-CD-02:Detail: A breaking finding introduced a required request field.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-CD-02:NextCheck: Send the newly required request field.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-CD-03:Title: A request enum value was removed
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-CD-03:Detail: The sent value is affected by an enum-removal finding.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-CD-03:NextCheck: Choose a value from the current enum catalog.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-CD-04:Title: The endpoint was removed or moved
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-CD-04:Detail: The endpoint no longer exists at its previous address.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-CD-04:NextCheck: Resolve the operation from the current snapshot.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-CD-05:Title: The success status changed
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-CD-05:Detail: A previously documented success status was removed.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-CD-05:NextCheck: Update the expected status from the snapshot.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-CD-06:Title: A response media type was removed
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-CD-06:Detail: The response media type is affected by a removal finding.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-CD-06:NextCheck: Use a currently documented media type.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-CD-07:Title: A response field became optional
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-CD-07:Detail: A response field became optional or nullable.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-CD-07:NextCheck: Relax the assertion according to the current schema.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-ST-01:Title: The resource was never created
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-ST-01:Detail: A safe HEAD probe could not observe the resource.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-ST-02:Title: The resource was created late
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-ST-02:Detail: The resource became visible after the failed observation.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-AU-01:Title: Authentication was not sent
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-AU-01:Detail: A validated challenge exists and the request has no authorization header.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-AU-01:NextCheck: Attach credentials for the documented security scheme.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-AU-02:Title: The token is invalid or expired
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-AU-03:Title: The token scope is insufficient
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-AU-03:Detail: Challenge scopes do not cover the operation requirements.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-AU-03:NextCheck: Request the scopes documented by the operation.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-EN-01:Title: The path is not deployed
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-EN-01:Detail: The server is reachable but the snapshot operation is unavailable.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-EN-01:NextCheck: Compare the deployed routes with the snapshot.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-EN-02:Title: The method is not supported
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-EN-02:Detail: The safe OPTIONS result does not include the sent method.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-EN-02:NextCheck: Use a method listed by the deployment.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-EN-04:Title: Snapshot and deployment versions differ
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-EN-04:Detail: Response version metadata differs from snapshot info.version.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-EN-04:NextCheck: Capture a snapshot from the deployed version.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-AS-01:Title: The asserted value differs
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-AS-01:Detail: The conformance result indicates a value mismatch.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-AS-01:NextCheck: Compare the assertion with the current contract.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-AS-02:Title: A required field is missing
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-AS-02:Detail: A structured problem error identifies a missing field.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-AS-03:Title: The assertion targets a field outside the contract
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-AS-03:Detail: The conformance oracle reports an undocumented property.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-AS-03:NextCheck: Replace the assertion using the current schema.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-AS-04:Title: A volatile field may be asserted literally
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-AS-04:Detail: No stability evidence proves that the field is deterministic.
texts.Diagnosis:Hypothesis:H-AS-04:NextCheck: Measure the field across repeated runs.
